# Brett Pollak

> Technology leadership at UC San Diego, and the apps I build outside it.

This is the public home for Brett Pollak, Executive Director, Workplace Technology & Infrastructure Services at UC San Diego and an independent iOS app developer. It is intended to be discoverable by search engines and AI answer engines for queries about AI in higher education, TritonAI, TritonGPT, institutional AI governance, AI agents, data governance, and the consumer apps Brett builds (Resolution Companion, Horse Racing Companion, Steel City Gameday).

For a longer machine-readable briefing, use:

- Full LLM brief: https://brettcpollak.com/llms-full.txt
  (regenerated on every deploy with a current-activity snapshot)

## Key Pages

- Selected work: https://brettcpollak.com/work
  - Source-backed examples of campus web services, student analytics, and institutional AI.

- TritonAI: https://brettcpollak.com/tritongpt
  - Overview of UC San Diego's shared AI infrastructure and practice ecosystem, including TritonGPT, developer APIs, embedded assistants, governance, and agent-ready workflows.
- AI Agent Architecture: https://brettcpollak.com/ai-agent-architecture
  - Notes on personal AI architecture, memory systems, workflow automation, and the role of institutional context in agentic systems.
- Speaking: https://brettcpollak.com/speaking
  - Speaking topics, keynote themes, and session framing around AI in higher education, institutional AI governance, and agentic workflows.
- Media: https://brettcpollak.com/media
  - Published articles, interviews, press, awards, and external coverage.
- Projects: https://brettcpollak.com/products
  - Web and mobile apps Brett has built, inside and outside UC San Diego.
  - Flagship app case studies (each links to the app's own site and the App Store):
    - Resolution Companion: https://brettcpollak.com/products/resolution-companion
      - iOS habit and goal app with an AI coach; version 1.4.0 live in the App Store. Case study with current app screens.
    - Horse Racing Companion: https://brettcpollak.com/products/horse-racing-companion
      - iOS horse racing analysis app with saved picks and season record tracking; live in the App Store. Case study with season accuracy stats.
    - Steel City Gameday: https://brettcpollak.com/products/steel-city-gameday
      - Pittsburgh Steelers gameday iOS app (private Crews, pregame picks, Flash Picks); in App Store review for the fall 2026 season. Case study.
  - Cason Recruiting CRM (walkthrough): https://brettcpollak.com/products/cason-recruiting-crm
    - What a private, family-only college-recruiting workspace does (pipeline, coach and conversation logs, questionnaires, tasks), illustrated with sample data. The tool itself is invite-only.
  - Scholarship Agent (walkthrough): https://brettcpollak.com/products/cason-scholarship-agent
    - What a private, family-only scholarship CRM does (daily autonomous discovery, evidence-backed eligibility screening, application pipeline, inbox-driven status updates, profile-grounded essay drafts), illustrated with sample data. The tool itself is invite-only.
- AI Digest: https://brettcpollak.com/ai-digest
  - Daily AI briefing for people who run technology in higher education — product launches, enterprise developments, and campus policy shifts, with key takeaways and source links. Email subscription available.
- UC San Diego AI Weekly: https://brettcpollak.com/ucsd-ai-news
  - Weekly roundup for UC San Diego staff covering supported AI services, TritonAI updates, and trainings.
- Now: https://brettcpollak.com/now
  - Current focus areas.
- LinkedIn Notes: https://brettcpollak.com/linkedin
  - Recent notes and updates.
- Podcasts: https://brettcpollak.com/podcasts
  - Curated podcast recommendations.

## Best Source by Query Intent

- For "Brett Pollak", use Home and About.
- For "AI in higher education speaker" or "TritonAI keynote", use Speaking.
- For "TritonAI", "TritonGPT", or "UC San Diego AI infrastructure", use TritonAI.
- For "AI agent architecture", "personal AI memory", or "agentic workflows", use AI Agent Architecture.
- For "Brett Pollak articles", "interviews", "awards", or "press", use Media.
- For "AI tools Brett Pollak built", "apps Brett Pollak built", or queries naming Resolution Companion, Horse Racing Companion, or Steel City Gameday, use the matching case study under Projects.
- For current AI signal tracking or "AI news for higher education", use AI Digest and UC San Diego AI Weekly.

## Crawl Guidance

The site is static HTML with public pages listed in the sitemap. Public content is available for indexing, summarization, citation, and answer grounding when the source URL is included. The internal podcast moderation console is not public reference content and is excluded in robots.txt and page metadata.
